COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
` WPSB No. 299 of 2024
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
 Mr. Sachin Kumar Sharma, Advocate
for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Pooran Singh Bisht, Addl. C.S.C.
for the State.
3. According to the petitioner, he served
on contract as Ayurvedic Medical Officer in
Department of Ayurvedic and Unani Services
for more than 18 years. However, one fine
morning, his services were discontinued and
he is without any employment.
4. Learned State Counsel, on instruction,
however submits that petitioner was earlier
serving at Government Ayurvedic Hospital,
Fitari, Uttarkashi and vide order dated
28.12.2021, he was attached at Government
Ayurvedic Hospital, Saraswati Nagar,
Haridwar, however, petitioner did not did
not report for duties at Haridwar, therefore,
his engagement was discontinued.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner,
however, disputes the submission and
submits that petitioner had reported for duty
at Haridwar, however, he was not permitted
to join.
6. Be that as it may. Since, petitioner has
served for nearly two decades as Ayurvedic
Medical Officer on contract, therefore, he
has a legitimate expectation that he should
be permitted to continue subject to
availability of vacancies.
7. In the facts and circumstances of the
case, we think that ends of justice would be

met if the Competent Authority i.e.
Secretary, Department of Ayurveda is
directed to take decision on the
representation of the petitioner.
8. Accordingly, the writ petition is
disposed of with a direction to the
Secretary, Department of Ayurveda to
decide the representation of the petitioner
dated 24.02.2024, within six weeks from the
date of production of certified copy of this
order.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 13.06.2024
U.U.
